book_title: From Doctor to Healer: The Mountain Lion's Gift
author: Erica M. Elliott
book_description: Dr. Erica Elliott's journey is a powerful transformational memoir that bridges modern medicine, spiritual awakening, and profound healing.In this final volume of her memoir trilogy, Erica begins as an eager medical student, devoted to conventional medicine and science. But her path takes an unexpected turn when toxic chemical exposure at the clinic where she works leaves her seriously ill. What follows is a devastating health collapse, a near-fatal accident, and experimental brain surgery that ultimately saves her life.This deeply personal healing journey memoir forces Erica to step away from mainstream medicine and into a world of spiritual healing, indigenous wisdom, and self-discovery. Guided by a prophecy spoken decades earlier by a Navajo grandmother, she slowly uncovers a deeper understanding of what it truly means to heal.From Doctor to Healer is a spiritual healing memoir and a true story of transformation, offering hope to readers navigating illness, burnout, or a calling beyond traditional paths. It is a compelling doctor memoir for anyone questioning conventional systems and seeking a more holistic way to live and heal.Show more
